evidence: degree 715 for all vertices (degree_min = degree_max = 715) and spectrum_integral is true with 5 distinct eigenvalues

with p = 3, c = 2 the eigenvalues 1 + 2*715 = 1431, 1 + 2*55 = 111 and 1 + 2*1 = 3 are all 0 mod 3, with multiplicities 1, 119 and 1700, so the predicted rank is 2380 - 1 - 119 - 1700 = 560, equal to board lower 560

why: the rule's code M = I + 2A over F_3 is predicted to have length 560, matching lower 560 and closing the bracket

reply.analysis: Proven: bracket [560, 560]. The lower bound is an independent set of size 560. The upper bound is the linear code M = I + 2A over F_3, whose length 560 meets it. The independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed. Wall time was 30.7 s, of which 28.8 s was LLM time and 1.9 s compute, with 4 LLM calls and 1 code tried. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha reached 560 but was not proven in 125 s. CP-SAT cover and fractional cover (2368.0) did not close. F2 minrank only gave 559. The earlier rule-based agent also certified 560 in 2.3 s, so it was faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious.
